name: thuso
description: THUSO: a modular business workspace for startups, SMEs and corporates. By Coding Wizards.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @thuso/core && npm run build -w @thuso/web && npm run build -w @thuso/functions
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @thuso/core && npm run typecheck -w @thuso/web && npm run typecheck -w @thuso/functions
scripts.test: npm run test -w @thuso/core && npm run test -w @thuso/functions
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-thuso "vitest run --config tests/rules/vitest.config.ts"
scripts.emulators: npm run build -w @thuso/functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-thuso --import ./.emulator-data --export-on-exit
